# Vendored material from ITUAIReadiness

Selected files from <https://github.com/CrashingGuru/ITUAIReadiness> (commit `84010da`), MIT licensed.
The licence is in `LICENSE` in this directory. It covers this directory only.

What is included:

- `dimensions.json` — AI Readiness 2.0 factors and dimensions.
- `node_map.json` — Y.3172 node to dimension mapping used by the reference use-case agent.
- `keywords.json` — keyword hints used by the reference router to tag dimensions.
- `summaries/` — short summaries written in that repository (not the official standards).

Third-party PDFs that the reference repository stores under `InputDocs/` are **not** copied here.
They are listed in `kb/ref_catalog.yaml` with their upstream path and are not redistributed.
